anomalies.description: A figure in dark clothing leaps onto the roof of a moving truck and engages in physical combat with a driver inside the cab, as seen in frames f1–f5 where the attacker is airborne and then enters the cab.

Inside the truck cab, two individuals are engaged in close-quarters physical struggle: one in dark clothing attacks the other (in uniform), who is restrained or pinned against the passenger side; visible grappling and forceful contact occur across frames f11–f14.

Two individuals inside a vehicle engage in physical combat: one person (driver) is seen grabbing and striking the other (passenger), who reacts defensively and appears to be subdued or injured; motion blur in f7–f9 indicates rapid struggle.

A police car is shown on a flatbed trailer moving at high speed on a highway, indicating it has been placed there following a collision or intentional placement; the context of subsequent shooting suggests a prior crash or forced stop.

A large vehicle (truck) sustains visible damage and emits smoke after being struck by gunfire; the impact causes structural deformation and tire/rim damage, constituting a vehicular incident due to external force.
A firearm is discharged from inside a vehicle, producing visible muzzle flash and sparks striking a nearby large vehicle (likely a truck), with smoke erupting from the impact point.
A large truck collides with or scrapes against a police car, generating significant smoke and debris; the vehicles are in direct contact.
Two individuals engage in close physical struggle inside a vehicle; one appears to be subduing or restraining the other, with visible grappling and body movement.
A large tanker truck collides with a police car at high speed, causing severe deformation of the police vehicle's front and side; debris and smoke erupt upon impact.
A person inside a police car is seen holding and aiming a rifle out the window; muzzle flash is not visible, but the weapon is clearly deployed in an aggressive posture toward the tanker truck.
A white police car is violently ejected from beneath a large aircraft's wing, tumbling through the air while trailing sparks and debris; it makes contact with the tarmac and begins to disintegrate.

A white police car is violently struck by the wing of a low-flying aircraft, lifted off the ground, and torn apart mid-air.; The wreckage of the vehicle continues to skid and tumble across the runway, with visible structural failure and smoke, confirming a high-impact crash sequence.
A bright flash and fireball erupt from the damaged vehicle upon impact or shortly after, indicating a secondary explosion or fuel ignition.
